subject: Multi-region architecture workshop — scheduling and attendees
messages:
From: Ryan O'Neill <ryan.oneill@stellarsight.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Multi-region architecture workshop — scheduling and attendees

Hi Olga / Monica,

Thanks again for the discovery session earlier this week — that was helpful. We'd like to move to a technical deep-dive to validate network/topology constraints and run through your recommended deployment patterns for multi-region failover. Key goals for us:

- Confirm KV cache / warm-start behavior across regions
- Understand routing & fallback heuristics when capacity is constrained
- Walk through our compliance requirements for EU data residency

Attendees from our side will be me (platform lead) and Priya Rao (cloud architect). I've attached our current infra inventory and a short list of constraints.

Available windows next week (all ET): Mon 6/21 10:00–12:00, Tue 6/22 14:00–16:00, Wed 6/23 09:00–11:00. If you have a preferred format (record + whiteboard, or interactive infra testbed demo), let us know.

Attachment: stellarsight-infra-requirements.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Ryan
Ryan O'Neill
Platform Lead, StellarSight
ryan.oneill@stellarsight.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ryan O'Neill <ryan.oneill@stellarsight.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Multi-region architecture workshop — scheduling and attendees

Hi Ryan — great to hear. Monica and I can run the deep-dive. Proposed plan: 90-minute working session with an optional 30-minute follow-up for hands-on routing checks. Draft agenda attached.

Possible slots we can cover (ET):
- Mon 6/21 10:00–11:30 (fits your first window)
- Wed 6/23 09:00–10:30
- Thu 6/24 13:00–14:30 (alternate)

Ben and Marcus will join for the kernel/quantization and KV-cache discussion respectively. We'll prepare a short traffic/latency profile baseline so we can discuss realistic SLOs.

Attachment: redwood-arch-workshop-agenda.pdf (pdf)

If Mon 10:00 ET works, I'll send a calendar invite and include a link to a shared Miro + a recording option. Also: do you have any restricted IP ranges or private peering notes we should review before the session?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

Hi Olga / team — thanks for the quick turn. Apologies — our cloud architect Priya won't be available Mon 10:00 ET (overlap with their deployment freeze). Can we nudge to Mon 6/21 11:00–12:30 ET instead? That still keeps it in the morning for our APAC folks who will join late afternoon PST.

Also, Priya added a short note: we have an existing private peering between our EU cluster and a partner network; she'd like to walk through packet flow and any IP allowlist considerations in the session. I've reattached our infra sheet with a new tab called "peering-notes."

Attachment: stellarsight-infra-requirements.xlsx (updated)

—Ryan
